name: Graz University of Technology
summary: Graz's technical university: 19 bachelor's taught in German, some with many English courses; German C1 is required to enrol.

ib.text: IB Diploma with 24+ points (not an IB Certificate); maths and a foreign language among your six subjects; three subjects at HL. German C1 is required; German as Language A in the IB counts as proof.

notes: Five bachelor's also need proof of English: Acoustics, Music, and Information Engineering; Chemical and Process Engineering; Computer Science; Information and Computer Engineering; Software Engineering and Management.
English as Language B in the IB counts as that English proof.
